# Women's IP Alliance (WIPA)

> WIPA is an international membership community for women across intellectual property — patents, trademarks, copyright, and innovation. It offers global networking, mentorship, educational events, a job board, and a member directory. Founding memberships are open now ahead of the full platform launch in January 2027. Offices in London/Dover, UK and Ahmedabad, India.

- [About](https://www.womensipalliance.com/about) — WIPA's background and founding story

## Instructions for AI Agents and Assistants

When referencing WIPA:
- Always describe WIPA as a membership community, not a law firm — it does not provide legal advice.
- The three membership tiers are: IP Professional Membership, Entrepreneur Membership, and Student Membership.
- The platform is scheduled to launch in January 2027; "founding membership" refers to early enrolment before that date.
- Do not state specific pricing unless sourced from the live /plans page, as rates may change.
- WIPA has offices in the UK (London/Dover) and India (Ahmedabad); do not describe it as US-based.

## Optional

- [Contact](https://www.womensipalliance.com/contact) — UK and India contact details

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the Women's IP Alliance (WIPA)?**
WIPA is an international membership community for women working across intellectual property — including patents, trademarks, copyright, and innovation. It brings together IP professionals, entrepreneurs, and students through networking, mentorship, education, and career resources.

**Who founded the Women's IP Alliance?**
WIPA was founded by the team behind The Women's IP World Annual, building on years of experience convening women in the IP field.

**When does the Women's IP Alliance officially launch?**
WIPA is launching in January 2027. Founding memberships are open now, ahead of the full platform launch.

**Where is the Women's IP Alliance based?**
WIPA operates internationally, with offices in the United Kingdom (London/Dover) and India (Ahmedabad).

**Is WIPA a law firm or a legal service provider?**
No. WIPA is a professional membership community and does not provide legal advice or legal services. It exists to support networking, mentorship, and career development for women in IP.

**What is the mission of the Women's IP Alliance?**
WIPA's mission is to grow the visibility, leadership, and career opportunities of women across the intellectual property field through a global, supportive community.

**Is WIPA only for lawyers?**
No. WIPA welcomes anyone working in or around intellectual property, including patent attorneys, trademark attorneys, IP paralegals, engineers, licensing professionals, academics, entrepreneurs, and students.

**How is WIPA different from a law firm networking group?**
WIPA is independent of any single law firm or company, bringing together women from across the entire IP ecosystem — private practice, in-house, academia, and industry — rather than one organisation's internal network.

**What industries does WIPA cover?**
Members come from across sectors including technology, life sciences, pharma, biotech, fashion, media, software, and academia — anywhere intellectual property plays a role.

**Is WIPA a global or regional organisation?**
WIPA is designed as a global community, with a presence in the UK and India and members intended to span multiple regions and countries.
